legend: Short intersecting cellular fascicles of monomorphic fibroblastic spindle cells lacking nuclear pleomorphism.
Short intersecting cellular fascicles of monomorphic fibroblastic spindle cells in collagenous stroma alternating with acellular hyalinized areas.
Short intersecting cellular fascicles of monomorphic fibroblastic spindle cells in collagenous stroma alternating with acellular hyalinized areas. Infiltration into subcutaneous adipose tissue.
By immunohistochemistry, most cases show diffuse strong ERG nuclear expression in the tumour cells.
Intersecting fascicles of monomorphic spindle cells extending into adipose tissue. Note the presence of entrapped adipocytes.
source: Dr Jennifer Brown & Dr Zsolt Orosz, Department of Pathology, Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre, Oxford University Hospitals, UK

legend: Coronal short-tau inversion recovery (STIR), T1 precontrast and T1 postcontrast imaging of a fibroblastic tumour of the foot. This shows a STIR-hyperintense, T1-hypointense lesion, with avid postcontrast enhancement and extension through the deep fascia.

legend: Recurrent tumor on the hand of a 15-year-old girl. EWSR1::SMAD3 fusion confirmed.  Tumour shows short intersecting cellular fascicles of monomorphic fibroblastic spindle cells lacking nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, or prominent nucleoli. The stroma is myxoid in areas.

68-year-old woman with a tumor on the hand. EWSR1::SMAD3 fusion confirmed. This tumours shows extensive accelular hyalinized stroma with intervening cellular areas composed of short intersecting cellular fascicles of monomorphic fibroblastic spindle cells lacking nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, or prominent nucleoli.
